title: Golf Round Strokes Gained Course Leaderboard
dataSources: Golf rounds (`golf:round`), Garmin golf telemetry (`garmin:golf`), UDisc rounds (`udisc:round`), launch-monitor shots (`launchmonitor:shot`), handicap-index updates (`handicap:index`).
app: Arccos and Garmin S62 round telemetry, UDisc round exports, launch-monitor CSVs, and handicap-index updates streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted imports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=golf:round
| stats avg(strokes_gained_total) as avg_value max(strokes_gained_total) as peak_value count as sessions by course_name
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks course values by average and peak strokes gained, helping you see where golf round strokes gained performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which course contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `course_name` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of course, average strokes gained, and peak strokes gained.
grandmaExplanation: It spots which course areas give you the strongest golf round strokes gained results.
